areas.name: Multiplayer Completion
areas.location_cue: Competitive lobby, mode and map selectors, multiplayer progression, Service Record, and identity customization.
areas.note: These rows require functioning PC online services and, for ordinary play, other participants.

items.label: Finish and win a Free-For-All match

levels.1: Learn the mode's scoring and boundary rules in a short private session first.
levels.2: Complete a full Free-For-All match, then secure a win in that mode.
levels.3: Select Free-For-All in public or private multiplayer, remain until the normal results screen, and record one completed match. Repeat until your side or individual score wins; do not quit when the winning threshold is reached because registration occurs at results.

items.label: Complete every supported multiplayer map and mode pairing

levels.1: Free updates expanded the launch selection, and some maps support only certain rule sets.
levels.2: Use the current PC lobby to play every map under every mode that permits it.
levels.3: Open each mode separately and record its available map list, including Rail Yard, Destroyed Town, River Front, Alpine Gorge, Castle, and imported free maps where shown. Finish one full match on every selectable pairing; do not invent pairings absent from the lobby.

items.label: Reach the final multiplayer reward tier

levels.1: Online rank is separate from campaign rank.
levels.2: Earn multiplayer experience until the highest reward-bearing rank in the current profile track is claimed.
levels.3: Finish public or private matches that grant experience, check the multiplayer progression page after each tier, and claim every weapon, skin, outfit, hat, and player-card reward. Continue through the final tier displaying a reward; campaign rank 40 does not satisfy this track.

levels.1: Many cards use unusual one-match actions rather than rank alone.
levels.2: Inspect every player-card padlock and complete its displayed condition.
levels.3: Open the multiplayer identity selector, read each locked card's requirement, and complete the action in the stated mode without leaving before results. Include rank rewards, weapon conditions, MVP-style results, distance records, and team actions until every gameplay card is selectable.

items.label: Complete every multiplayer medal and ribbon tier

levels.1: Build sessions around one short condition at a time.
levels.2: Clear every competitive medal tier and earn every competitive ribbon shown in Service Record.
levels.3: Use private matches where permitted for precise conditions, but remain through results. Complete cumulative kill, win, distance, weapon, team, and MVP tiers, then perform every single-match ribbon condition; verify each icon before moving to another ruleset.

areas.name: Axis Invasion Completion
areas.location_cue: The campaign Invasion toggle, Axis matchmaking, progression tracks, skills, loadouts, and Service Record.
areas.note: Attacker and defender unlock counters are separate; all online rows depend on current matchmaking services.

levels.1: Leave invasion enabled after learning the operation's routes and telephones.
levels.2: As campaign host, eliminate an invading player and finish the invasion result.
levels.3: Enable Axis Invasion for a roaming operation, use phones sparingly, track unusual alerted patrols, and eliminate the invading player. Remain until the invasion result registers; a disconnect may not count as a defender win.

levels.1: Use allied patrol reports to narrow the host's route without exposing your own position.
levels.2: Enter Axis Invasion matchmaking and eliminate the host player.
levels.3: Queue as the Axis sniper, mark friendly patrols, react to their alert state, and reposition after every shot. Eliminate the host rather than ordinary guards, then remain for the completed invasion result.

items.label: Claim every Axis Invasion reward milestone

levels.1: The first win is only the beginning of the attacker progression track.
levels.2: Advance the Axis elimination counter through its final displayed reward.
levels.3: Continue winning as the invading sniper, open the Axis progression page after each session, and claim every weapon, attachment, outfit, skin, and cosmetic milestone. Stop only when the last displayed attacker reward is selectable; a single win does not clear the track.

levels.1: Host victories use a separate progression counter.
levels.2: Advance the defender counter through its final displayed reward.
levels.3: Keep Axis Invasion enabled as campaign host, defeat invaders, and claim each defender milestone from the invasion progression page. Continue until every host-side cosmetic and equipment reward is selectable; attacker wins do not advance this counter.

items.label: Complete every Invasion medal and ribbon

levels.1: Host and attacker actions populate different Service Record pages.
levels.2: Clear every displayed tier and one-session ribbon on both sides of Axis Invasion.
levels.3: Work through attacker and defender pages separately: cumulative wins and eliminations build medals, while special phone, tag, distance, trap, survival, and rapid-action conditions must register within one invasion for ribbons. Stay through each result and verify the icon.

areas.name: Secrets, Cooperative Play, and Shooting Range
areas.location_cue: Reproducible environmental targets, Photo Mode, cooperative Mission Select, and the standalone Shooting Range.
areas.note: Only verified repeatable secrets are included; no image or fabricated sketch is attached.

levels.1: The riverside rail district hides training props on ledges, roofs, and industrial structures.
levels.2: Find and shoot all ten cardboard pigeons in the riverside rail district.
levels.3: Sweep both riverbanks with binoculars, inspecting the old town, rail structures, rooftops, and bridge approaches. Destroy each cardboard bird with one shot and use the mission-specific Service Record counter to confirm ten; stone targets are a separate category.

levels.1: The valley weapons site hides small painted figures around farms, walls, and storage clutter.
levels.2: Find and shoot all ten gnomes in the valley weapons site.
levels.3: Sweep garden edges, farm buildings, wall openings, roadside clutter, and the windmill sector with binoculars. Shoot every painted figure and verify the mission-specific counter reaches ten before extracting.

levels.1: One small figure sits where a bridge railing has an unusual opening.
levels.2: At the bridge, face the gnome positioned inside a gap in the central railing and enter Photo Mode.
levels.3: Stand directly in front of the gnome at the centre of the bridge, frame it clearly, and open Photo Mode while facing it. Wait for the hidden record to register before leaving; merely shooting or viewing the figure does not satisfy this interaction.

items.label: Hit the farthest Shooting Range target

levels.1: The formal range extends beyond its obvious central boards.
levels.2: Use a rifle to strike the most distant target visible from the Shooting Range firing point.
levels.3: Enter the standalone Shooting Range, use binoculars to scan past the near target bank, equip a stable rifle, and compensate for the measured distance before firing. Check Service Record for the extreme-range practice medal.

items.label: Pierce the Shooting Range deadeye target

levels.1: A practice target rewards penetration rather than a routine centre hit.
levels.2: At the Shooting Range, align a shot that passes through the deadeye target as required by its practice record.
levels.3: Equip a rifle and suitable ammunition, align the marked deadeye target with a valid surface or target behind it, then fire through the first target so the penetration registers. Confirm the practice medal rather than assuming any ordinary hit counts.

levels.1: Shared tags, revives, and objective roles make map cleanup easier.
levels.2: Finish every base and downloaded roaming operation with a cooperative partner.
levels.3: Host or join each installed full map, complete its required objectives, and remain together through extraction and results. Include all four mission add-ons and verify the cooperative statistics afterward; the fixed distant-vantage sequence has no equivalent roaming checklist.

items.label: Test every installed weapon and ammunition type

levels.1: The range exposes entitlement and attachment problems without risking an operation run.
levels.2: Fire every installed rifle, secondary weapon, pistol, special ammunition type, and unlocked attachment configuration in the Shooting Range.
levels.3: Cycle through the full installed arsenal, load standard and special ammunition, fire each weapon, and test all sights, suppressors, magazines, stocks, and conversion options unlocked by workbenches or challenges. Revisit Steam installation if an owned weapon remains absent.
